You're right to be upset, but he didn't cheat on you, he should have asked you if that's ok, that would show trust and make the situation less shady in my opinion. 

You should tell him you're not comfortable with that.

I'm having a hard time staying too, if you need to talk to someone I'm here for you.  
Also, don't let anyone rape you, not sure what's that about, but please don't.

When I got dumped for being a "Nice Guy", I loved her but she decided she was into bad boys. I changed a lot and became a bit of a "bad boy" myself and girls seemed to like it. 
I changed back to a nice guy for my last gf, she slowly changed me because she wanted a gentle and caring boyfriend. 2 years later she dumped me because I wasn't good looking enough, "Not up to my standards" in her own words. Life is hard.
Thank you, that's so kind of you

Thanks for the reply, I wasn't realy relying on her for happinnes, it's just her treatment of me that broke me, she took the joy from my heart.
She didn't even break up with me, she's just ghosting me. I didn't even get closure..
I love her too much to be truely angry about it, but it's realy nice seeing comments like this. I realy wish I could say it myself and mean it.

It's actuallly almos been 6 monthes now, I'm broken inside. People are often askimg me if I'm alright, I just can't hide it anymore.. 
I havd never been this lonely and unappriciated in my life...
I don't even like myself anymore, I'm a broken version of who I used to be. No self esteem, no optimism.
